jobs.title: Merchandising Execution Associate MARLBOROUGH
jobs.description: Are you someone who thrives on helping others succeed, enjoys making an impact, and takes pride in guiding customers to the right solutions for their projects? If youâre also naturally curious and eager to keep learning, consider starting or growing your career with us at The Home Depot. Position Overview Merchandising Execution Associates (MEAs) perform in-store merchandising service activities such as merchandising projects, planogram maintenance, overhead organization, and display/signage maintenance designed to enhance the customer experience. MEAs execute merchandising strategies and ensure product is displayed correctly to drive sales and maximize inventory turns. MEAs work in teams with on-site supervision, and provide service to multiple departments in the stores. These associates execute approved general bay service, tasking, projects and resets safely, accurately and efficiently. MEAs must build and maintain strong relationships with store associates and provide superior customer service to both internal and external customers. Key Responsibilities Merchandising: General Service, Tasking, Packdown, and Projects Read and interpret directions to ensure merchandise is set to the planogram, project instructions, program service requirements and general service guidelines Straighten, clean and merchandise product to ensure merchandise is presented in a visually appealing manner Maintain copy of most recent planogram inside upright beam adjacent to product set Build displays and fixtures using basic hand tools Maintain, order, and install display material/signage/brochures Follow directions and processes to conduct accurate price and label changes. Replace incorrect, damaged, or missing price labels. Maintain aisle Utilize store systems to access key merchandising reports. Read, interpret, and execute action based on findings. Maintain bay service records and other documentation as directed. Execute one off projects as required by store, district, and regional leadership. Customer Service Maintain aisle cleanliness so that merchandise is accessible and customers are able to move throughout the aisles easily Partner with store leadership to markdown all damaged or un-sellable merchandise Answer questions regarding the store and products for the customers. Partner with store associates to find necessary products to fit the customer's needs. Other Partner with store representative to conduct inspections of returned and damaged items for Return to Vendor. Follow standard operating and safety procedures. Complete assigned training curriculum Other duties as assigned Competencies Action Oriented Collaborates Communicates Effectively Customer Focus Decision Quality Skills Basic computer skills with knowledge of web based applications. Interpersonal skills, working on teams, with heavy reliance on team to accomplish goals. Follows safety policies and procedures. Identifies and corrects safety hazards. Attention to Detail: Stays attentive and aware, catches errors before completing assignments, and maintains high quality standard for work. Drives Execution & Self Motivated: Demonstrates the ability to deliver results without close supervision despite a large workload, competing demands, and fast paced environment. Ensures tasks are completed on time, without error, and meet quality standards. Direct Manager/Direct Reports Reports to Merchandising Execution Supervisor (MEAS) Travel Requirements No travel requirements for this role Physical Requirements Bending, stooping, reaching, twisting, lifting, pushing, pulling, and moving items Working Conditions Working within a flexible schedule that typically starts early in the morning Warehouse environment that can be dusty and noisy Doors are frequently open, causing drafts and interior temperature changes Minimum Education GED Highschool Diploma or Equivalent Minimum Years Of Work Experience N/A Minimum Leadership Experience N/A Certifications N/A Other Requirements/Assets 1 year

jobs.title: Recognizing the Friction
jobs.description: Virtual works adequately for many meetings. But how big is the gap between adequate and optimal for any given meeting? The mode decision should weigh the meeting's importance against the friction of meeting in person â not default to either one. tClara survey of 522 US-based business leaders, including 95 C-suite respondents Across 26 meeting goals, 43% of leaders rate in-person as the better mode, 35% say virtual, and 22% say mode barely matters â the decision is genuinely goal-dependent, not a fixed rule. In-person is the preferred mode for 22 of 26 goals â especially building trust and teamwork, persuading or selling, and solving important problems. Virtual is preferred for goals like gathering diverse opinions, sharing updates, and using people's time efficiently. Virtual meetings are seen as nearly twice as likely to produce a negative outcome as in-person meetings (47% vs. 25%) â convenience carries real risk. 70% of leaders say a deliberate blend of virtual and in-person work allows them to do their best work; C-suite respondents value in-person meetings more than other leaders do (53% vs. 41%). Wir suchen jemanden, der den gesamten Integrationslebenszyklus verantwortet: Design, Entwicklung, Release und Betrieb. Wer den Flow entwirft, baut ihn auch, deployt ihn und betreut ihn. Ein echter Generalist. Peter : Konkret bedeutet das: Entwurf von Integrationsflows mit Designer – von einfachen Point-to-Point-Verbindungen bis hin zu komplexen Orchestrierungen. Entwicklung von Services in der webMethods Flow-Sprache (BRANCH, MAP, INVOKE, LOOP, SEQUENCE) und in Java, Aufbau von Adapter-Integrationen (SAP, JDBC, Salesforce & Co.) sowie Implementierung von Datentransformationen mit DTL oder XSLT. Markus : Und danach fängt der eigentliche Spaß an: Releases über CI/CD-Pipelines mit Deployer, Command Central und Tools wie Jenkins oder GitLab CI – über DEV, TEST, UAT und PROD hinweg. Im Betrieb: Monitoring mit My webMethods und Optimize, Incident-Behebung, Performance-Tuning – und Ruhe bewahren, wenn eine Broker-Queue volläuft oder der Thread-Pool erschöpft ist. Joachim : Ein weiteres großes Thema bei unseren Kunden ist die Migration von anderen Integrationsplattformen auf webMethods – zum Beispiel von TIBCO, MuleSoft, Oracle SOA Suite, SAP PI/PO oder hauseigenen ESB-Lösungen. Und die webMethods-Welt steht nicht still: Seit der IBM-Akquisition heißt alles IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration – also ist jemand, der auch mit Containern und Cloud-Integration gearbeitet hat, genau richtig für uns. Peter : Was uns wichtig ist, ist ein solides Fundament: Integrationspatterns wie Request-Reply, Pub/Sub, Dead-Letter-Queues und durchdachtes Fehlerhandling – plus ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie webMethods APIs bereitstellt und konsumiert (REST, SOAP/WSDL). Linda : Und wie viel Erfahrung sollten sie mitbringen? Joachim : Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit webMethods – Integration Server, Broker oder Universal Messaging, Designer. Jemand, der Integrationsprobleme selbstständig lesen, debuggen und beheben kann. Aber ehrlich gesagt: Wenn die Erfahrung nah dran ist, aber nicht exakt, und wer Integrationslösungen wirklich End-to-End durchdenkt, wollen wir trotzdem sprechen. Markus : Als Bonus freuen wir uns über Erfahrung mit dem webMethods API Gateway, webMethods B2B (Trading Networks), Managed File Transfer mit webMethods MFT (ActiveTransfer), Optimize für SLA- und Prozessmonitoring – oder mit LDAP-Integration, SSL/TLS-Setup sowie Clustering und Hochverfügbarkeit im webMethods-Stack. Annabelle : Genauso wichtig wie die Technik: Jemand, der sich mit Ambiguität wohlfühlt und eine vage formulierte Anforderung in eine funktionierende Integration verwandeln kann, der Probleme nicht weitergibt, sondern löst, der klar kommuniziert – auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern – und der von Tag eins an an Logging, Alerting und Recovery denkt. Und da sich unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Zagreb schon auf einen regelmäßigen Austausch freuen, sind sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse wichtig. Peter : Ob das Wissen aus einem Studium, einer Ausbildung oder Jahren in Enterprise-Projekten stammt, ist für uns sekundär. Wichtig ist, dass es vorhanden ist – zusammen mit der Neugier, mit den webMethods-Releases Schritt zu halten. Linda : Super, dann stelle ich die Anzeige online. Wir arbeiten mit dem deutschen Mittelstand (KMU) und Großunternehmen zusammen, oft in regulierten Umgebungen mit strenger Datensouveränität . Das bedeutet auch, dass für diese Rolle eine EU-Staatsangehörigkeit zwingend erforderlich ist, damit es uns erlaubt ist, AI-Systeme innerhalb der Realität von Legacy-Systemen und komplexen Prozessen zu bauen.“ Linda: „Das klingt herausfordernd. Prototypen sind der Startpunkt, nicht das Ziel. Wir bauen Systeme, die tatsächlich laufen, egal ob on-premises oder in der Cloud . jobs.title: Large Loss Handler
jobs.description: We’re on a mission to make migration easy. We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. About the team Our Large Loss Specialists handle Marshmallow’s most complex and high-value motor claims, often involving catastrophic injuries such as brain and spinal trauma, psychiatric injury, complex fractures and nerve damage. Beyond handling claims, the team acts as a centre of technical expertise, sharing insights and driving consistency across Claims. We work closely with Complex Personal Injury colleagues, reinsurers, panel solicitors and teams across Claims, Underwriting and Pricing to deliver fair, commercially sound outcomes. As a small, highly technical team, we offer broad exposure and the opportunity to grow your authority quickly. What you'll be doing Managing a portfolio of high-value motor claims, typically valued above £250,000, through pre- and post-litigation. Investigating liability, indemnity and coverage while setting proactive, commercial and empathetic claim strategies. Reserving accurately for complex injuries and future losses, using the available evidence and tools such as PI Calc. Identifying recovery opportunities (subrogation, contribution, and beyond) and ensuring they're actioned by the relevant teams. Collaborating with panel solicitors, reinsurers and internal teams to reduce claim lifecycles, control legal spend and pursue recovery opportunities. Shaping our Large Loss strategy while coaching colleagues and sharing technical knowledge across Claims. Your expertise Strong experience managing high-value or catastrophic motor bodily injury claims with current authority of at least £250,000. Deep knowledge of liability, indemnity, causation, reserving, future losses, the Ogden discount rate and complex medical issues. Experience handling litigated claims and applying relevant procedures and frameworks, including CPR, PPOS and MIB technical disputes. Who you are You balance empathy for customers with proactive, commercial decision-making. You investigate complex issues thoroughly and own your decisions through to settlement. You explain technical judgments clearly and build effective partnerships with internal and external stakeholders. You share your expertise, seek feedback and want to help shape a growing Large Loss function. Perks & benefits Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year #LI-PT1 Diversity of thought We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The Fraud Intelligence Team The Fraud Intelligence Team is a small, newly expanding team that defends Marshmallow against fraudulent activity through investigative analysis and industry intelligence. The team goes beyond rules-based fraud checks - we exist to detect new policy fraud trends, investigate networks, and find what automated systems miss. Think ghost broking rings, organised misrepresentation, identity fraud, and patterns that only surface through deep, creative investigation. This is an early-stage function with a lot to build, and you'll have a direct hand in shaping what it becomes. We’re hiring a Senior Fraud Intelligence Analyst to bring experience to the team - someone who has investigated policy insurance fraud before and can hit the ground running while helping shape what this function becomes. Please note we are not in a position to offer sponsorship and/or a visa for this position. What you’ll be doing Investigating fraud networks end-to-end: taking a single alert signal and expanding it into a full intelligence picture across linked policies, devices, addresses and identities Using tools like device fingerprinting, banking data, identity verification, quoting history and telematics to build evidence for cancellation Analysing internal policy data at population level to identify emerging fraud trends before they become entrenched Working with data science to develop and refine fraud detection models, network analysis tools, and automated alerting systems Building and expanding fraud detection capability across the policy lifecycle Working with AI tools and SQL to query data, spot patterns and accelerate investigations Documenting investigations and producing intelligence reports for internal stakeholders and external bodies (IFB, IFED, CIFAS) Mentoring and quality-assuring the work of more junior analysts in the team Who you are You think like an investigator: you see connections others miss, and when something doesn't add up, you dig until you understand the full picture You're confident making subjective judgements under uncertainty - jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Lead Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team at Pleo. In this role, you'll define and deliver the SecOps roadmap, building the detection, response, and investigation capability that protects a fast-growing fintech. If you're excited about owning a security operations function end to end, from framework-based strategy through to the code that makes it run, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you'll be working with and reporting to You'll report to our VP of Fraud & Security and work closely with Fraud, DevSecOps, Engineering, and Risk & Compliance. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to protecting Pleo's customers and their money. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across the organisation and to bring less experienced security engineers up with you as the function matures. What you'll be doing As a Lead Security Operations Engineer, you will: Build and own a structured SecOps roadmap grounded in well-known frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and CIS benchmarks. Lead security investigations and digital forensics, from suspicious traffic through to full incident response, and bring the findings back into how we detect and prevent. Design, tune, and scale our SIEM and logging pipeline through standardized log ingestion across services so signal isn't lost in the noise. Strengthen our perimeter and authentication posture, including WAF configuration, authorisation tuning, and monitoring for suspicious traffic. Protect sensitive data through DLP controls, and make sure the coverage matches where the data actually lives. Improve our on-call rotation for the team, defining the alerting, escalation paths, and response SLAs that make it work. Automate detection and response workflows, using code and AI to reduce manual toil and shorten time to resolution. Reduce SecOps-attributed risk identified through compliance gaps, and collect the evidence that demonstrates it. Build dashboards and reporting that give the team and leadership real visibility into response times, coverage, and risk reduction. Work cross-functionally with engineers who don't have a security background, translating threat models into changes they can actually ship. What you bring You'll thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a closely related discipline, with a proven track record of materialised risk reduction through monetary impact, incidents contained, forensics that changed outcomes. A strong development and engineering background. You are comfortable writing the automation, not just specifying it. Hands-on SOC and SIEM management experience, including detection engineering and log pipeline design. Experience in scale-up environments, where you've built capability

jobs.title: Personaldisponent – Vertrieb & Recruiting (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Jobbeschreibung Personaldisponent (m/w/d) – Kunden gewinnen, Talente platzieren Du willst nicht drei Jahre lang zuarbeiten, bevor dir jemand ein eigenes Kundensegment anvertraut? Dann solltest du weiterlesen. In vielen Häusern wirst du erst einmal in einer Nische geparkt: entweder Vertrieb oder Besetzung, sauber getrennt, und der Wechsel dauert. Wir halten das für Zeitverschwendung. Als Personaldisponent (m/w/d) verantwortest du bei uns die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette – du sprichst Unternehmen an, verstehst ihr Personalproblem, verkaufst die passende Lösung und bringst sie danach selbst zum Erfolg. Ein Job, zwei Disziplinen, ein Ergebnis, für das du geradestehst. Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Herzen von Bielefeld. Wir sorgen dafür, dass unsere Kunden als Arbeitgeber sichtbar werden und verlässlich passende Bewerbungen bekommen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Hoffnungsprinzip. Der Markt dafür wird nicht kleiner: Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung sorgen jedes Jahr für mehr Bedarf. Was dich bei uns als Personaldisponent (m/w/d) erwartet Verdienst ohne Deckel: Ein solides Fixgehalt bildet die Basis, deine Provision kennt keine Obergrenze. Was du leistest, siehst du auf dem Kontoauszug. Unbefristeter Vertrag von Tag eins: Wir stellen niemanden auf Probe ein, den wir nicht langfristig halten wollen – in einer Branche, die stabil wächst. Zwei Kompetenzen, ein Profil: Du wirst gleichzeitig im Vertrieb und in der Personalgewinnung stark. Einarbeitung mit System: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Trainings in Akquise, Beratung und Besetzung sowie feste Feedbackgespräche statt Sprung ins kalte Wasser. Ausstattung, die Spaß macht: Höhenverstellbare Schreibtische, Stühle von Herman Miller, Apple-Hardware (MacBook Air/Pro oder iMac) – und das mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Fitness inklusive: Wir übernehmen deinen Premium-Vertrag im Studio deiner Wahl. Versorgung im Büro: Siebträger (Faema E61) mit Julius-Meinl-Bohnen, gute Tees und ein flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü. Kurze Wege: Leistungsorientiert, aber kollegial – die Geschäftsführung sitzt im selben Raum, gute Ideen landen nicht in der Schublade. Deine Aufgaben im Detail Kundenseite – du holst die Aufträge rein Du gehst aktiv auf Unternehmen zu, telefonisch wie per Direktansprache, und machst sie neugierig auf unsere digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen. Du hörst genau hin, wo es beim Personal wirklich klemmt, leitest daraus den konkreten Bedarf ab und entwickelst einen passenden Ansatz. Du stellst deine Lösung überzeugend vor und führst die Gespräche bis zur Unterschrift. Besetzungsseite – du lieferst ab Sobald der Auftrag steht, übernimmst du die Steuerung: Kampagnenaufbau, Laufzeit, Nachsteuerung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung. Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Vorqualifizierungen und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidaten den Prozess in guter Erinnerung behalten. Dein Handwerkszeug Du pflegst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, hast deine Pipeline jederzeit im Griff und arbeitest auf klar messbare Ziele hin. Du stimmst dich eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung ab und bringst eigene Vorschläge ein, wie wir besser werden. Was du mitbringen solltest Lust auf Vertrieb: Akquise schreckt dich nicht ab, sondern reizt dich – ob am Telefon, im Video-Call oder vor Ort beim Kunden. Beratungsgespür: Du stellst die Fragen, die weiterführen, erkennst Ansatzpunkte und erklärst deine Lösung nachvollziehbar. Gefühl für Menschen: Du kannst dich in Personalverantwortliche genauso hineinversetzen wie in Bewerber. Antrieb und Ausdauer: Du organisierst dich selbst, lässt dich von einer Absage nicht bremsen und gibst dich nicht mit Durchschnitt zufrieden. Und ganz wichtig: Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg aus dem Verkauf – dein Lebenslauf interessiert uns weniger als deine Einstellung. Erfahrung in der Personaldienstleistung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Das Fachliche bringen wir dir bei. So läuft deine Bewerbung ab Zwei Minuten, kein Anschreiben

jobs.title: Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Stellenbeschreibung Hi, ich bin Felix Lippe. Vor ein paar Jahren habe ich Lippe Personal gegründet. Heute sind wir über 25 Leute und eine der führenden Recruiting-Agenturen für medizinische Praxen in Deutschland: Ärzte, Zahnärzte, Physiotherapeuten, Pflege. Wir haben in den letzten Jahren hunderte Praxen betreut und tausende Bewerbungen für unsere Kunden generiert. Das Geschäft läuft. Und jetzt kommt der Teil, warum ich diese Stelle ausschreibe. Ich baue das Unternehmen gerade grundlegend um: weg von manueller Arbeit, hin zu einem KI-gesteuerten Unternehmen. Nicht als Buzzword auf der Website, sondern als echtes Projekt, an dem ich täglich selbst arbeite – mit Tools wie Claude Code, n8n und einem eigenen KI-Setup. Ich tausche mich dazu laufend mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten aus, ich stecke tief im Thema. Was mir fehlt, ist nicht das Wissen und sind nicht die Ideen. Was mir fehlt, ist Zeit und eine rechte Hand, die mit mir baut. Genau das ist diese Stelle. Die Rolle: Werkstudent mit Founder-Associate-Charakter Du arbeitest nicht „bei uns in der IT". Du arbeitest mit mir. Direkt, auf Geschäftsführer-Ebene, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen. Konkret heißt das: Wir schauen uns gemeinsam an, wo im Unternehmen noch manuell gearbeitet wird, und dann bauen wir das weg. Du bekommst von mir klare Briefings, setzt eigenständig um, und wir sprechen uns in einem festen wöchentlichen Termin ab – oft auch öfter, weil ich Sparring liebe. Du bist bei strategischen Themen dabei, verstehst, warum wir Dinge tun, und siehst, wie ein Unternehmen von innen umgebaut wird. Wenn ich mich mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten austausche, bekommst du das mit und lernst direkt daraus – genau wie ich. Das ist der Deal: Du hebelst meine Zeit, ich gebe dir Einblicke und Verantwortung, die du als Werkstudent sonst nirgendwo bekommst. Deine Aufgaben Du baust mit KI-Tools (vor allem Claude Code) Automatisierungen für unser Tagesgeschäft: Bewerbermanagement, Reporting, Anzeigenerstellung Du optimierst, automatisierst und digitalisierst Prozesse quer durchs Unternehmen – vom Vertrieb bis zum Fulfillment Du setzt Workflows in n8n auf und verbindest unsere Tools miteinander (Airtable, HubSpot, GitHub) Du dokumentierst, was du baust, so dass es als System im Unternehmen bleibt und wächst Du bist mein Sparringspartner: Wir entwickeln gemeinsam weiter, wie dieses Unternehmen in zwei Jahren arbeitet Was ich dir biete 20 Euro pro Stunde – bewusst am oberen Ende für Werkstudenten in Düsseldorf, weil ich lieber einen richtig Guten habe als drei Mittelmäßige 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel um deinen Vorlesungsplan herum, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr Nach der Einarbeitung weitgehend Homeoffice. Unser Office in Düsseldorf steht dir jederzeit offen Professionelles KI-Setup ab Tag eins (u. a. Claude Code Max Plan) – du arbeitest mit Tools, die die meisten Unternehmen noch nicht mal kennen Direkter Zugang zu allem, was ich lerne: aus dem Austausch mit KI-Agenturen, Experten und aus unseren eigenen Projekten Echte Verantwortung statt Praktikanten-Aufgaben: Was du baust, läuft danach jeden Tag in einem echten Unternehmen Eine Erfahrung, die dich von praktisch jedem Absolventen abhebt: Du hast nicht über digitale Transformation gelesen, du hast eine mitgebaut So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess Bitte kein klassisches Anschreiben, das liest hier keiner. Stattdessen: Bewerbung über das Formular – Lebenslauf plus (das ist mir am wichtigsten) ein Link zu irgendetwas, das du gebaut hast: GitHub-Repo, kleines Tool, Automatisierung, Uni-Projekt. Größe egal. Dazu zwei, drei Sätze, was du zuletzt mit KI gelöst hast Probeaufgabe – wenn deine Bewerbung passt, bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe (zwei bis drei Stunden Aufwand) 30-Minuten-Call mit mir – wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen Entscheidung innerhalb von 48 Stunden. Versprochen Ich freue mich auf dich. Felix Lippe Geschäftsführer, Lippe Personal GmbH Dein Profil Ich halte das bewusst offen, weil mir deine Denkwe

Improve robustness of perception algorithms under varying environmental conditions. Support the integration of perception components into the overall autonomy architecture. Deploy models on GPU-enabled edge platforms Develop internal tools for testing, visualization and debugging perception pipelines. Collaborate closely with Robotics, Embedded, Mechanical and Systems Engineering throughout the complete product development lifecycle. Solid understanding of deep learning fundamentals (CNNs, transformers) Hands-on experience developing object detection and pose estimation models. Experience with PyTorch Experience with OpenCV or comparable computer vision frameworks. jobs.description: Wir suchen keinen angestellten Geschäftsführer, der ein fertiges Unternehmen übernimmt. Euro externes Eigenkapital eingeworben und den Prozess von Investorensuche und Pitch bis Term Sheet und Closing selbst geführt. jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond. We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination. We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Overview We are hiring a Head of Produc t to define, build, and scale the product vision behind the company’s AI operating system for industrial supply. This is a mission-critical leadership role with full ownership to lead the product organization across multiple markets. You will shape the architecture, roadmap, and execution machinery that powers sourcing, sales, logistics, financing, and automation across six markets. This role requires a product leader who combines technical depth, AI-first thinking, commercial intuition, and strong cross-functional alignment . You will lead Product Management, Product Design, and cross-functional Discovery, working closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Data, Sales, Procurement, Logistics, and Finance to drive product development from concept to execution. Your mandate: make the company’s platform the most reliable, predictable, and autonomous operating system in the industry , delivering high-quality, scalable solutions that meet customer needs and drive measurable business impact. As part of our management leadership team, you will have a pathway to multi-region oversight, a highly competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives, and the opportunity to shape a high-performance organization from our Berlin headquarters, backed by top-tier investors. Key Responsibilities Own the Product Vision & Strategy Define and scale the end-to-end operating system for materials trade, transforming fragmented workflows into automated, AI-driven processes. Build a unified product strategy across sourcing, pricing, ordering, logistics, financing, claims, and supplier management. Translate business priorities into a clear, measurable, and compounding product roadmap that drives long-term competitive advantage. Hire, mentor, and lead a high-caliber team of Product Managers and Product Designers. Establish a strong product operating cadence with weekly reviews, clear success metrics, and crisp, consistent communication. Foster a culture of rapid iteration, pragmatic decision-making, and operational excellence across the product organization. Deliver Business Impact Improve conversion, retention, and reactivation through superior buyer and supplier experiences. Lift automation rates across the entire trade lifecycle — from quote to cash. Reduce operational overhead by replacing manual processes with intelligent, autonomous system behavior. Model the company’s office-only, high-energy culture — fast cycles, clear decisions, and tight collaboration every day. Lead and Scale AI-Driven Product Development Partner with Engineering, AI/ML, and Data teams to design agentic workflows for sales, procurement, and customer operations. jobs.title: Supply Chain Controller (all genders)
jobs.description: Willkommen bei Glow25! Bei Glow25 verbinden wir Beauty mit Wissenschaft und modernster Technologie – KI gehört bei uns ganz selbstverständlich zum Arbeitsalltag. Als Deutschlands führende Kollagen-Marke begleiten wir Menschen dabei, sich in jeder Lebensphase wohlzufühlen und ihre natürliche Schönheit zu unterstreichen. Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir Menschen mit Substanz: zuverlässig, motiviert und mit echtem Interesse daran, gemeinsam etwas Bedeutendes aufzubauen. Bei Glow25 triffst du auf ambitionierte Ziele und ein Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung fördert und Leistung wertschätzt – unabhängig davon, welche Rolle du übernimmst. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Das sind unsere aktuellen Herausforderungen und perspektivischen Ziele: Als Supply Chain Controller (all genders) baust du ein modernes Controlling für unsere Lieferkette auf und agierst als Business Partner für unser Operations Management Team. Du sorgst für Transparenz in einem Bereich, der für unser Wachstum entscheidend ist, und bringst deine Controlling-Expertise direkt in operative Entscheidungen ein. In diesem Bereich brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Vorratsbewertung und entwickelst das Inventory Controlling kontinuierlich weiter. Du baust Transparenz über Bestände, Warenbewegungen und deren finanziellen Einfluss auf. Du analysierst zentrale Supply-Chain- und Operations-KPIs wie Bestände, COGS, Logistikkosten und Forecast Accuracy. Du agierst als Business Partner für Operations, Supply Chain und Procurement und bringst finanzielle Perspektiven in operative Entscheidungen ein. Du unterstützt bei Budgetplanung, Forecasts und der operativen Finanzplanung. Du baust Dashboards, Reportingstrukturen und KPIs auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Du erstellst Business Cases für operative Entscheidungen, zum Beispiel zu Lieferanten, Logistikstrukturen oder Bestandsstrategien. Du identifizierst Kosten- und Working-Capital-Optimierungspotenziale entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Du bringst folgende Erfahrungen mit: Du hast ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Finance, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Fachbereichs abgeschlossen. Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Controlling, Operations Finance, Supply Chain Analytics oder Consulting mit. Du hast einschlägige Erfahrungen mit Beständen, Kostenstrukturen oder operativen KPIs. Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest datengetrieben und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge klar und verständlich aufbereiten. Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und behältst auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld den Überblick. Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel oder Google Sheets und bewegst dich sicher in der Welt der Zahlen. Du hast Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Tableau oder bist motiviert, dich schnell einzuarbeiten. Du hast idealerweise bereits mit ERP-Systemen oder Finanzsystemen gearbeitet. Du interessierst dich für Datenanalyse, Reporting und die Entwicklung aussagekräftiger KPIs. Das sind Charakterzüge, die Dich beschreiben: • Du bist analytisch stark und liebst es, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen. • Du bist ein Teamplayer mit ausgeprägter Kommunikationsstärke. • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert. • Du bist proaktiv und bringst Themen selbstständig voran. • Du bist flexibel und behältst auch in dynamischen Situationen den Überblick. Diese Rolle passt eher nicht zu dir, wenn... ...du am liebsten für dich allein arbeitest und wenig Austausch mit anderen Teams suchst. Die Rolle lebt vom laufenden Business Partnering mit Production, Supply Chain und Procurement. ...dir der Einstieg ins Controlling noch fehlt. Wir suchen jemanden mit bereits gefestigter Praxiserfahrung, nicht für eine Einstiegsposition. ...du dich ungern mit Tabellen, Kennzahlen und Datenanalyse beschäftigst. Excel/Google Sheets sind hier tägliches Handwerkszeug. ...du feste Prozesse ohne Weiterentwicklung bevorzugst. Darauf kan

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: FRYTE is redefining how electric logistics connects with the energy grid. From our base in Munich, we're building the intelligence layer that powers the transition from diesel to electric freight. Our SaaS platform enables fleet operators, dispatchers, and charge point operators to plan, optimize, and monetize electric truck charging — aligning fleet efficiency with grid stability. Our vision: replace big oil with smart electrons. Our mission: get e-trucks on the road – faster, smarter, more efficiently. Tasks This is a deep technical role for someone who wants to go deep , not climb an org chart. You'll be the technical anchor of our backend — the engineer who sets the quality bar, owns the hardest design decisions, and quietly makes the whole system more robust and scalable. The person the rest of the team brings their thorny problems to, and who's genuinely happy to dig in. We're explicit about this: this is an IC role with a Staff Engineer trajectory. No management obligation, ever. Your influence comes through architecture, code, and mentorship — not headcount. If your idea of growth is becoming the person whose judgement defines how a system is built, this is for you. One note on the title, because it travels badly between companies: we don't measure seniority in years, or in features shipped inside one familiar framework. We measure it in scope of ownership — systems you were responsible for when they broke, designs you had to revisit once reality showed up, assumptions that scale quietly humbled. Most good engineers learn that lesson several times, usually the annoying way. We'd rather hire someone who already has. You'll work directly with the founders (former TUM researchers with deep energy + logistics expertise) on the integration layer that makes electric freight actually work: multiple domains, real production traffic. What You'll Do Own the architecture and production-hardening of our backend as we scale from seed onward Design and version stable, multi-domain APIs (multiple integrations, real-time data streams) Build the observability backbone — logging, tracing, metrics — so we operate with confidence, not hope Raise the bar across the codebase: patterns, ADRs, reviews, and the unglamorous work that keeps things maintainable Mentor and unblock the team through code and conversation — lift everyone's ceiling Move fluidly into DevOps, SRE, or frontend when that's what the problem needs Our Stack Backend: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, PostGIS Frontend: React, TypeScript Infra: AWS Requirements A track record of owning production backend systems in Python (FastAPI) on SQL/Postgres — not just building in them. Carrying something you designed through deployment, failure, and the redesign that followed. (That depth usually takes 5+ years to earn; the years themselves aren't the point.) Strong backend and system design instincts — you reason about boundaries, failure modes, and versioning before you write the first line Architectural depth, ideally in charging, fintech, scheduling, or similarly stateful, integration-heavy domains A habit of operating across boundaries — backend, infra, the occasional frontend fix, sometimes code you had no business touching — because the problem never cared what your job description said A teaching reflex: you have an answer to most things and you're happy to share it Bonus: GitHub Actions, observability tooling (tracing/logging/metrics), SRE practices, and a track record of maintaining or contributing to OSS — because you find it fun . Most of all: we hire for trajectory and attitude. We're looking for the humble, curious expert who's a mentor and coach by instinct — not because it's in the job description. Benefits 🌍 Impact that matters – every system you harden helps decarbonize logistics. 🚀 Foundational ownership – you define the architecture an entire platform is built on, at exactly the stage where that work compounds. 📈 A real IC ladder – Senior → Staff, with the founders invested

jobs.description: About Phaidra Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation. The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades. Specifically: We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions. We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them. Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR . Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Qualification path No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn. jobs.title: Senior Python Engineer - AI Coding Agent Evaluation (Freelance)
jobs.description: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency. Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves: We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks. You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments: Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust What this is NOT: Not data labeling Not prompt engineering Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate What we look for: 8+ years in software development Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis Experience writing tests (functional, integration) English proficiency - B2+ Why this is hard: Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds. jobs.title: Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Women's Health and Organ Health)
jobs.description: Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team of Bioinformatics Scientists in our Women's Health and Organ Health research organization. You will oversee the scientific planning and execution of research and assay-development of diagnostic projects, and you will be responsible for creating production-ready pipeline components. You will manage your team and its professional growth, the research strategy behind new product development, and the handoff of research work into production. The role calls for deep experience in algorithm and assay development, NGS data processing across multiple modalities, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product research and development in a regulated (CLIA) setting. You will evaluate new technologies and NGS assays, implement methods to optimize performance, and help define the product profile from a bioinformatics perspective, with input from R&D, Product, and Laboratory Directors. Primary Responsibilities: Team Leadership and Development: Lead and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and the standard the team holds itself to. Research Strategy: Own the research strategy behind new product development, from scoping through execution, working with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order. Assay Science: Lead bioinformatics analysis for assay development and optimization, and troubleshoot experiments alongside laboratory scientists. This spans multi-omic approaches including methylation and fragmentomics and other cell-free DNA (cfDNA) derived features. It also spans short-read and long-read sequencing and both hybrid-capture and amplicon target enrichment. Study Design and Data Quality: Partner with laboratory teams on study design at the research and feasibility stage, covering new technology assessment, optimization, and performance determination. Make sure the resulting data holds up before anyone builds on it. Analysis Method Improvement: Advise and prototype improvements to analysis pipelines, including variant detection, quality control, and modality-specific processing: methylation calling, fragment-size and end-motif analysis, error suppression for deep targeted panels, and structural-variant calling. Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and containerization. Automate the routine parts of research data management, pipeline execution, and reporting so the team's time goes to science. Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off. We do not screen for prior experience with these tools, and many strong candidates come from environments where they were restricted; we provide the tooling and the ramp time. Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company. What success looks like after a year: The team has a research roadmap you own, and progress against it is visible outside the team. You independently advise and guide research strategies in cross functional settings. New analysis methods from your team are implemented within production code and demonstrate expected performance on benchmark studies.. You and team members become trusted experts that other functions direct their hard questions to, and can independently support decision making. AI agent-assisted work is normal on the team, with a standard for it that you set. Qualifications: Ph.D. in Bioinform

jobs.title: Freelance Agent Evaluation Engineer
jobs.description: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency. Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment. What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks. You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments: Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust What this is NOT Not data labeling Not prompt engineering Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate What we look for 5+ years in software development Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis Experience writing tests (functional, integration) English proficiency - B2+ Why this is hard Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds. How it works Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid Effort estimate Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted. Compensation Up to $50/hr equivalent , depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule. Originally posted on Himalayas
